scientific_question: If a small, mechanically defined QntySpot-style buy-weakness / sell-recovery ladder had been selected using DEV history only, would that frozen ladder have produced economically useful terminal WETH wealth and/or drawdown characteristics on genuinely unseen OUTER history versus simple predeclared baselines after AMM fee, intended-size price impact, turnover, and explicit gas sensitivity?
claim_boundary: Exploratory only. One asset path cannot prove alpha. No scientific validation, trading authority, capital authority, promotion, or stronger claim is permitted.

canonical_binding.reacquisition_policy: Preserve this Git artifact; do not reacquire bindings from live network.

history_boundary.t0_definition: first eligible canonical pool-state observation at or after historical reconstructability

numeraire.terminal_inventory_valuation: Exact hypothetical executable liquidation of all remaining KRAKMASK against the final eligible reserves, including 997/1000 fee, intended-size impact, and liquidation gas; never frictionless spot.

execution_semantics.source_path: exact chronological InkySwap V2 pool reserve observations
execution_semantics.observable_state: only after its source event/block is complete
execution_semantics.decision_information: only information known at or before observation k
execution_semantics.simultaneous_entries: aggregate scheduled WETH inputs into one hypothetical AMM trade
execution_semantics.invalid_fill: NO_FILL; never synthesize partial fills or mutate historical reserves

capital_rule.search: descending integer WETH atomic units from 1 WETH until the exact impact predicate passes
capital_rule.largest_scheduled_trade: all three scheduled entries aggregated when all are crossed
capital_rule.cycle_budget: all available WETH cash at cycle start; gas is charged separately and no leverage, borrowing, shorting, core sleeve, or protected inventory sleeve exists

candidate_family.candidate_order: spacing ascending, then profit target ascending

mechanics.anchor: first eligible observable spot at interval start; after each full exit, observable spot at that exit fill state
mechanics.crossing: all newly crossed unfilled levels schedule before the next legal fill
mechanics.exit: one full inventory sell when executable proceeds >= exact aggregate acquisition cost * (1 + P)
mechanics.rearm: all entries rearm and anchor resets only after a full exit

amm_economics.price_comparison: Use exact rational reserve ratios and cross multiplication; no binary floating-point threshold decisions.
amm_economics.reserve_path: immutable historical reserves; hypothetical trades never update subsequent reserves
amm_economics.impact_definition: exact fee-adjusted constant-product average execution versus pre-trade reserve spot, excluding the 997/1000 fee
amm_economics.fee_attribution: Report exact WETH-equivalent fee using the input fee for buys and pre-trade reserve-spot conversion of the token fee for sells.
amm_economics.impact_attribution: Report exact WETH-equivalent gap between fee-adjusted no-impact execution and actual fee-adjusted constant-product execution at pre-trade reserve spot.
amm_economics.terminal_inventory_mark: one exact hypothetical executable full liquidation against final eligible reserves, including fee, impact, and liquidation gas

baselines.definition: hold identical initial WETH for the interval
convert the entire allowed initial WETH at the first legal executable interval state using exact V2 economics; hold inventory to interval end; liquidate exactly

four equal WETH allocations at 0%, 25%, 50%, and 75% elapsed calendar time; first eligible state at or after schedule, with strict later-block fill when a decision observation is required; hold and liquidate exactly
anchor-reset three-entry -5%, -10%, -15% equal-WETH grid; full executable exit at acquisition cost * 1.05; same chronology, impact, fee, gas, rearm, and terminal liquidation
the one DEV-selected frozen candidate, with identical initial wealth and mechanics in OUTER

baseline_contract.selection_exclusion: DUMB_SYMMETRIC_GRID is not part of candidate selection

cost_model.intended_size_impact: exact constant-product execution from historical reserves for every hypothetical trade
cost_model.turnover: include every hypothetical acquisition and liquidation

gas.sample_rule: chronological valid DEV swap receipts; if n >= 30, select indices floor(i*(n-1)/29) for i=0..29
gas.quantiles: sort exact values; nearest-rank P50/P90 with rank ceil(q*n)-1

cost_model.primary: AMM fee + exact impact + selected gas per hypothetical transaction
cost_model.stress: AMM fee + exact impact + DEV_GAS_P90 per hypothetical transaction

metrics.equity: WETH cash + exact executable liquidation proceeds of inventory at each observation - applicable liquidation gas
metrics.drawdown: maximum drawdown from the chronological executable-equity series
metrics.secondary_sharpe_sortino: optional only; one executable-equity value per UTC day using that day's final eligible state; never a selection criterion

accounting_contract.state_units: token and WETH balances are integer atomic units
accounting_contract.reported_wealth_units: exact rational WETH-equivalent values with canonical numerator/denominator serialization; no binary floating-point decision arithmetic
accounting_contract.cycle_compounding: completed exits return realized WETH to cash; the next cycle budget is all available cash after prior costs; no external deposits, withdrawals, leverage, borrowing, or hidden sleeve
accounting_contract.gas_timing: charge one declared gas amount per hypothetical transaction, including terminal liquidation when inventory is nonzero
accounting_contract.terminal_inventory: record inventory before liquidation and separately record executable liquidation value and gas
accounting_contract.replay_integrity: chronological replay must reproduce balances, fills, costs, equity, and counters exactly

ranking: if tied within <= 1 atomic WETH unit: lower maximum drawdown
dev_result_required_fields: primary and stress cost model identity

result_classification.VALID_PROMISING: valid OUTER; selected ladder terminal WETH exceeds HOLD_WETH and DUMB_SYMMETRIC_GRID under primary costs; positive advantage under at least primary gas; no accounting, replay, or integrity failure
result_classification.VALID_NOT_PROMISING: valid OUTER and failure to outperform both HOLD_WETH and DUMB_SYMMETRIC_GRID under primary costs, or cost drag makes the mechanism economically unattractive
result_classification.VALID_INCONCLUSIVE: valid execution but weak history/liquidity/sample, gas uncertainty changes the principal conclusion, or benchmark trade-offs prevent a defensible call
result_classification.buy_and_hold_tradeoff: BUY_AND_HOLD_KRAKMASK may outperform while lower drawdown remains a separately reported trade-off; do not redefine success
